'''Rocantor''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==History==
Colonized by [[Human/Legends|Human]] settlers, the native [[Rocanar]] managed to live in peace with the Humans for several years. However, all would change when the Rocanar were infected by a plague in [[500 BBY/Legends|500 BBY]]. Overtime, the plague spread to the Rocantori who died in droves. Enraged by the spread of the plague, the Humans sold all surviving Rocanar into slavery offworld and banned non-Humans from visiting Rocantor.
